title: NAVI (Sui) old package versions — closure re-verified; staging checkpoint-bug residual ≤$0.39
closed_reasons: Lineage A (main market, original pkg 0xd899cf7d…, 26 versions): all v1–v25 abort on the live version gate — v1–v13 inline storage::version_verification expects 2–6 (abort 43000); v14–v25 version::pre_check_version expects 7–15 (abort 1400); only v26 (constant 16) matches live Storage/IncentiveV2/IncentiveV3 version=16 (dev-inspect matrix, CI).

No ungated value-moving entry in any of 52 scanned package versions / 818 modules; no unprivileged writer of any version field; v9 incentive_v2::claim_reward aborts 7999; v22 incentive_v3 gate aborts 1400; v26 claim is user-scoped (sender/AccountCap), saturating, market-id-checked, with 0 payout for a fresh user (positive control).
Main V2 funds pools (9) and legacy v1 IncentiveBal (59) all balance 0; legacy incentive claims are ungated but valueless.

Staging deployment (0xa49c5d1c…, 21 versions, live objects v15, current v21 matches) has a documented reward-checkpoint bug (navi-smart-contracts PR #13 closed unmerged): proven payout +15,918,193 raw vSUI to an existing supplier with no prior claim; bounded by 8 active pools' remaining budgets + NAVX/vSUI funds balances = ≤0.2818 vSUI + 0.2036 NAVX ≈ $0.39 (dust).

Staging V2 funds pools (USDT $98.5k + USDC $98.4k) are unreachable via claim_reward (their IncentivePools are inactive; get_pool_from_funds_pool scans pool_objs only) → admin-only (P) via withdraw_funds(&OwnerCap) held by active address 0xdf6bff0f….

Oracle package (0xca441b44…, 5 versions; live PriceOracle v4) is version-gated (only v5 passes) and cap-controlled (OracleAdminCap/OracleFeederCap owned by 0x39c70d4c…); v5 keeper path accepts only signed external data.
key_facts: Main lineage gate constants by version: v1..v26 = 2,2,3,3,3,5,5,5,6,6,6,6,6,7,8,8,9,10,10,11,12,13,14,15,15,16; live Storage 0xbb4e2f4b… version=16 paused=false; only v26 (0x512f2826…) executes.
Dev-inspect gate matrix (all 26 versions, storage::version_verification on live Storage): v1–v13 FAIL abort 43000; v14–v25 FAIL abort 1400; v26 SUCCESS.

Reward-fund census (44 objects, $875,104.21 at 2026-10-10 ~02:40 UTC): main v3 RewardFunds 15 = $674,547.89 (vSUI $429.1k, DEEP $113.3k, FDUSD $78.3k, WAL $25.6k, NAVX $18.4k, NS $6.5k, rest dust); staging v3 13 = $3,499.58; staging v2 7 = $197,056.74 (USDT+USDC, admin-only); main v2 9 = $0; legacy v1 59 = $0.

Staging checkpoint bug reachable today: claim_reward (v21) pays index_reward/RAY × effective_amount for users missing from index_rewards_paids (paid defaults to 0); dev-inspect proof: sender 0x9f4c3fee… (haSUI balance 929,608,909, absent from the pool's 3-entry paid table) received +15,918,193 raw vSUI.

Staging active-pool extraction bound: vSUI pools remaining 0.2818 vSUI (fund balance 50.11 vSUI) + NAVX pools remaining 3.05 NAVX capped by fund balance 0.2036 NAVX ≈ $0.39 total; 186 inactive pools (incl. all USDT/USDC budgets) unreachable.

Main-market v26 claim path positive control: claim_reward_entry for a fresh user SUCCEEDS with zero payout; market-id consistency checks (verify_market_storage_incentive / verify_market_incentive_funds) present.
No unprivileged version writer: version_migrate functions are StorageAdminCap/OwnerCap-gated (friend for incentive_v3); admin caps owned by 0x39c70d4c… (main) and 0xdf6bff0f… (staging, active).
Finding's original raw figures (1.5M/869k/385k) are approximate/stale; current exact balances are in analysis/reward-funds-census.json.
caveats: dev-inspect (simulateTransaction, checks disabled) only; no transactions signed or sent; shared-object reads resolve at latest version.

The staging ≤$0.39 bound assumes an attacker can deposit haSUI/NAVX into the staging market (Pool<haSUI>/Pool<NAVX> are live shared objects and Storage is unpaused, but a full deposit→claim→withdraw PTB was not executed end-to-end; the payout mechanism itself is dev-inspect-proven).
USD values are point-in-time (DefiLlama/CoinGecko at 2026-10-10 ~02:40 UTC); balances move with claims/deposits (three main funds decreased mid-census).

H-O figure is the full reward-fund backing (upper bound; includes any admin-withdrawable remainder; exact user-owed split not quantified). P figure is the staging V2 funds recoverable by the OwnerCap holder.
The legacy main v1 incentive claim family is ungated (legacy Incentive object 0xaaf735bf… has no version field) but all 59 legacy balances are 0 today.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ≈$0 from NAVI's main market (all 25 old package versions abort on the live version=16 gate; only v26 executes; no ungated value path) plus ≤$0.39 dust on NAVI's staging deployment via a documented reward-checkpoint bug; $875k of reward funds are H-O/P reserves, not attacker-extractable.
